# ADF-W0.10 CPK/SQLite Migration Prerequisite Audit

**Generated by:** `scripts/adf_cpk_audit.py` (AST scan, read-only, no live state touched).

**Direct `sqlite3.connect(...)` call sites outside `src/core/_db.py::open_program_db`/`open_program_db_with_retry`:** 31 across 20 file(s).

A direct-connect site is not automatically a defect -- some are legitimate one-off tooling. This list orders them so ADF-W1.x work (outbox, unit-of-work, actuation) can see which stores are still outside the sanctioned connection helper before building on top of them. Cross-check with `vertex doctor --storage --program <id>` for the live canonical-path picture (ADF-W1.9); this script does not query live program state.
